newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, Fla., puts sales tax hike on ballot.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, Fla., puts sales tax hike on ballot.

text.p: Florida's Orange County Commission has approved a referendum on a proposal to raise the sales tax for school, road and park projects.

The commission voted 6-1 Tuesday night to send the measure to the county's 370,000 registered voters. Ballots are to be mailed out in mid-October and must be returned to the county election supervisor's office by Nov 4.
The proposal would raise the tax to 7 percent from 6 percent for 10 years, raising $2.2 billion for about 30 projects that will be listed on the ballots.
More than 40 of Florida's 67 counties already have similar local-option sales taxes for special projects.
